## Key Decisions
- **All 4 taxonomies certified (DEC-033, 2026-06-18)**: `ripley_v1.json` (12 SIGNAL/20 NOISE), `ml_v1.json` (70/1), `paris_v1.json` (14/1), `falabella_v1.json` (15/1). 0 orphans. 0 uncovered financial_groups. Certified by automated gate.
- **Certification Gate mandatory (DEC-034, 2026-06-18)**: `test_certification_gate.py` (27 tests) must pass for any deployment. Fails on: exec ≠ waterfall, conservation broken, DTE coverage drop, taxonomy orphans, frontend logic, mutable API contracts.
- **Case-insensitive SQL mandatory (DEC-035, 2026-06-18)**: ALL marketplace/financial_group queries must use `LOWER()` because RIPLEY uses UPPERCASE (INGRESOS, DEVOLUCIONES) while others use lowercase.
- **DTEIndexer heuristic limitation accepted (DEC-036, 2026-06-18)**: 68 XMLs procesados (62 PARIS + 6 FALABELLA) en `dte_truth_v1` pero 0 vinculados a ledger. Requiere order_id matcher (no implementado). PARIS/FALABELLA folio_xml coverage remains 0%.
- **PARIS Duplicate Cert ERRONEOUS (DEC-020, 2026-06-11)**: Certificación anterior ($21.2M, 1,573 groups) SOBRESTIMÓ 93%. Solo 133 source-born duplicates ($1.5M). Root cause: dedup key excluded SKU/descripción, collapsing multi-item orders. Cero loader bugs. Cero ledger contamination.
- **PARIS = Dropshipping 1P (DEC-021, 2026-06-11) — INVALIDATED by DEC-023**: Original conclusion that PARIS is 1P is INCORRECT. Based on misinterpretation of DTE 43 (Liquidación-Factura confirms agency model, not supplier liquidation). 17 sellers identified. Cencosud is agent, sellers are principals. Replaced by DEC-023.
- **Facturacion PARIS NO está vacío (DEC-022, 2026-06-11)**: 62 XML DTE files exist in `01_Raw/PARIS/Facturacion/`. Previous CLAUDE.md statement was incorrect.
- **PARIS = 3P Marketplace (DEC-023, 2026-06-11)**: PARIS is 3P marketplace, NOT 1P dropshipping. 17 sellers (UUIDs in `categoria`). DTE 43 (Liquidación-Factura) confirms Cencosud as agent, sellers as principals. 15% margin = marketplace commission. **Replaces DEC-021.**
- **Financial Truth Consolidation (DEC-001)**: Marketplace Financial reemplaza Reporte_Gerencial_Marketplaces como fuente oficial corporativa. Reporte_Gerencial = LEGACY.
- **DB OFICIAL: `data/db/meli_financial_v4.db`** (DuckDB, 125 MB, SHA256 e1e341ef). NO usar `database/marketplace.db`.
- **PARIS XML set reemplazado**: 154→54 XMLs. Bridge methodology sigue válida. Cobertura cuantitativa reducida.
- **RIPLEY 0 MD5 shared**: Sprint A3 FASE E (100% copies claim) INVALIDATED. Resto de A3 vigente.
- **P0→P3**: Incidente de DB fue falsa alarma. Root cause: sqlite3.connect() crea archivos vacíos.
- **P0→P1**: Date parsing bug. Permanent loss = $0. All value conserved in 46 source XLSX files.
  - 48.5% MATCH, 29.5% SWAP (temporal displacement), 20.7% NaT (recoverable), 1.4% pre-2025 intentional
  - 10,755 rows verified from source files, $358,012,384 total intact
- **"A pagar" es treasury/settlement, NO P&L**: 11,683 rows ($206.9M) tiene financial_group=NULL por diseño. Es el espejo del neto P&L. 50/50 mensual comprobado estructuralmente.
- **ML adjustment problem identified as #1 margin risk**: 90.3% of gross charges ($339.4M) returned as credits ($306.6M). Net take rate 3.7% vs gross 38.8%. ML net revenue 3× more sensitive to adjustment ratio than to GMV.
- **RIPLEY es el revenue engine más estable**: 17.9% take rate, proporcional, $63.3M net. Sin ajustes ni dependencias externas.
- **PARIS commission ($48.7M) es implícita**: embedded in P&L spread, no visible in ledger. Revenue engine = commission 3P, NOT retail margin.
- **3 monetization models identificados**: commission-driven (RIPLEY/FALABELLA), commission-driven (PARIS/3P), adjustment-eroded + ads (ML).
